title: Product Designer - Physical Products
description:
**Design the tangible face of CricHeroes.**


At CricHeroes, we’ve revolutionized how grassroots cricketers play, record, and celebrate the game.


Now, we’re ready to bring that same innovation off the screen into the hands of players everywhere.


From smart equipment to thoughtful packaging, we want every CricHeroes product to *look, feel, and perform* like it belongs on the world stage.


And to do that, we’re looking for a **Product Designer** who can bridge creativity, usability, and engineering, designing cricket products that are both beautiful and functional.


###### **The Challenge**


We’re building the next generation of cricket gear and accessories, functional, sustainable, and distinctly CricHeroes.


You’ll help us turn early ideas into real, tangible products, from packaging concepts and physical form factors to manufacturing ready designs.


It’s a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of *aesthetics and utility*, and who’s excited to shape the design identity of a growing cricket brand.


###### **What We’re Looking For**


* **4–7 years of experience** in **industrial or physical product design**, ideally in **consumer goods, sports, or lifestyle products.**


* A strong portfolio showcasing concept to production design, from ideation sketches to prototypes and finished products.


* Proficiency in 3D modeling and rendering tools such as SolidWorks, Rhino, Fusion 360, KeyShot, etc.


* Understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, and ergonomics.


* Experience designing packaging systems that balance aesthetics, sustainability, and practicality.


* Attention to detail, coupled with the ability to think systemically across a product range.


* Strong communication and collaboration skills. You can work with engineers, marketers, and external vendors alike.


###### **What You’ll Do**


* Conceptualize and design physical products that embody CricHeroes’ identity, from cricket gear to branded accessories.


* Develop packaging and unboxing experiences that delight users and tell our brand story.


* Collaborate with cross functional teams to bring designs from sketch to prototype to production.


* Explore materials and manufacturing methods to achieve quality, scalability, and sustainability.


* Partner with vendors and suppliers to ensure designs meet cost, quality, and timeline expectations.


* Build and maintain CricHeroes’ physical product design language, ensuring consistency across products, packaging, and merchandising.


* Develop “design” as a differentiator for our products, whether it is trend forward external design elements or shaping the actual design of new products.


###### **About CricHeroes**


CricHeroes is the world’s largest cricket network with **50\+ million users**.


We help grassroots cricketers showcase their talent, gain recognition, and improve their game through data and technology.


Now, we’re extending that mission into tangible products, the kind that every cricketer can see, touch, and be proud to use.


We believe in fewer rules, more ownership, and loads of candour.


You’ll join a team that values curiosity, craftsmanship, and the drive to make things that truly matter.


Ready to shape the look and feel of CricHeroes’ physical products?


  
Join our team and change the way cricket is played forever. Please send your resume to talent@cricheroes.in

title: Interactive Web Experience Designer
description:
###### **Design world\-class web experiences that power the digital face of grassroots cricket**


CricHeroes is the world’s largest cricket network, helping more than 50 million cricketers showcase their talent, gain recognition, and improve their game through data.


###### We’re looking for an **Interactive Web Experience Designer with 3–4 years of experience** who can combine UI/UX thinking, visual design, motion, and front\-end development to create compelling digital experiences for cricket communities worldwide.


###### **What You’ll Do**


###### **Web UI/UX Design**


* Design intuitive, visually compelling websites, landing pages, and interactive experiences.
* Own the process from user flows and wireframes to high\-fidelity UI, prototypes, and developer hand\-off.
* Create responsive, accessible, and consistent designs across devices and browsers.
* Build and maintain reusable components and design systems in Figma.
* Improve existing experiences using user feedback, analytics, and usability insights.

###### **Front\-End Design \& Development**


* Convert Figma designs into polished, responsive web pages using HTML5 and CSS3\.
* Use JavaScript to create interactions, transitions, and dynamic experiences.
* Write clean, reusable code and collaborate with developers to ensure design accuracy.
* Optimize web pages and visual assets for performance, accessibility, and SEO.

###### **Score Tickers \& Motion**


* Design and animate live score tickers, match graphics, scorecards, and cricket\-data experiences.
* Create engaging transitions and micro\-interactions using After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or similar tools.

###### **AI\-Assisted Design \& Innovation**


* Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, visual exploration, prototyping, content, and front\-end development.
* Evaluate AI\-generated work critically while maintaining originality, quality, privacy, and brand consistency.

###### **What We’re Looking For**


* 3–4 years of experience in web design, UI/UX design, or a related role.
* A strong portfolio featuring responsive websites, UI/UX work, and interaction or motion design.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma, including Auto Layout, components, variants, and prototyping.
* Strong working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with practical JavaScript skills.
* A strong eye for typography, colour, hierarchy, layout, and visual storytelling.
* Understanding of responsive design, accessibility, browser compatibility, and web performance.
* Experience with Photoshop, Illustrator, or comparable visual design tools.
* Strong communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and attention to detail.
* Genuine interest in cricket, sports, or fan\-focused digital experiences.

###### **Added Advantages**


* Experience with Blender, Spline, Three.js, or other 3D tools.
* Familiarity with React, Webflow, Framer, WordPress, SVG animation or Canvas.
* Experience designing sports graphics, real\-time data interfaces, or broadcast experiences.

###### **About CricHeroes**


CricHeroes is the world’s largest cricket network, with more than 50 million users. It helps local cricketers showcase their talent, gain recognition, and improve their game with data.


We are made in India by passionate cricketers, for passionate cricketers around the world.


**Apply If This Sounds Like You**


If you’re excited to combine design, technology, motion, and cricket—and want to help build a one\-of\-a\-kind platform for cricketers worldwide—we’d love to hear from you.


Please apply with:


* Your updated résumé
* A portfolio featuring web UI/UX and responsive design work
* Links to live websites or front\-end projects you have worked on
* Motion, ticker, interactive, or 3D work, if available
* A brief note describing your contribution to each featured project

**Let’s build the future of cricket together.**


  
Join our team and change the way cricket is played forever. Please send your resume to talent@cricheroes.in
